record_type_quote: The original investigation conducted by Shelton-Strong and Mynard (2018, 2021) on the use of a confidence-building diary with university students was replicated with younger students aged 13–14 years old (Spricigo, 2023).

targets.title: Promoting positive feelings and motivation for language learning: The role of a confidence-building diary.
targets.evidence_quote: The original investigation conducted by Shelton-Strong and Mynard (2018, 2021) on the use of a confidence-building diary with university students was replicated with younger students aged 13–14 years old (Spricigo, 2023).
targets.outcome_quote: In the original study, all the participants felt that the CBD-based intervention was beneficial. In the replication study, although the CBD was generally well-received, a minority of participants did not find it motivating.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Positive feelings and basic need satisfaction agree, but authors explicitly contrast preferred receptive activities with original speaking preference and contrast universal original benefit with a minority not motivated. Conclusion endorses effectiveness of the tool, rather than issuing an overall verdict on all replication findings.

reasoning: Reports the completed conceptual replication with 42 younger learners. The detailed design and result comparison identify the 2021 empirical paper as the target; the co-cited 2018 affective-factors paper is not separately identified as another re-tested finding. Spricigo (2023) is the thesis reporting this replication, not another original.
